steps.do: If an activation call returns an error, act on what it names. 'Wrong activation tool': check issue_reason, unlock the tool the error names, and call it with the same details. 'Card verification failed': count it as an incorrect card-details attempt; ask once more, and after 2 incorrect attempts tell the customer the card is locked and they must visit a branch in person, then stop. A PIN error: ask for a new PIN that is exactly 4 digits and not sequential or repeating, then retry. A CVV or last-4-digits format error: ask the customer for that detail again, then retry. 'already active', 'Only PENDING cards can be activated' or 'no longer open': explain that the card cannot be activated and why, and stop. Any other error: explain it to the customer (activate_system_error).
